messages:
marie.cs: Hey team — VerdantAI asked for a 90-min interactive inference workshop focused on Redwood Dedicated migration + quantization best practices. Need to lock date/time and facilitators. Options below. Please react or reply with availability.

ashley.enable: I'm +1 for Wed 9am PT or Thu 4pm PT. Prefer Wed.

tom.se: Thu 4pm PT works better for me (avoids sprint demo). Can take the "runtime tuning" slot.

diego_success: Customer prefers later EMEA overlap if possible. Are there any 3pm ET options?

marie.cs: Poll (pick primary + backup): 1) Wed 2026-04-15 09:00 PT / 2) Thu 2026-04-16 16:00 PT / 3) Fri 2026-04-17 13:00 PT (ET overlap). Please vote here: https://tinyurl.com/verdantai-workshop-poll

ashley.enable: Voted 1 & 3. I'll prepare the pre-read and a short demo notebook (Colab link).

marie.cs: Pre-read checklist (short):
```
- access to Redwood demo org (grant to verdantai@redwood.com)
- model artifact (gpt-small-quant.v2) on S3 link
- sample prompts and SLA targets
```
Can someone confirm the demo org invite is sent? @ops_bot

ops_bot: Scheduled calendar draft created: https://calendar.redwood.com/evt/abc123. Draft invites sent to verdantai contact and @marie.cs @ashley.enable @tom.se. Change requests via thread.

tom.se: I'll assemble the quick perf dashboard and share a short runbook for fallback (max tokens, quant profile toggles).

diego_success: Also adding a 15-min post-workshop follow-up slot for renewal conversation. Customer likes that format.

marie.cs: Nice — final asks: who can take host+Q&A (moderator) and who can do deep-dive labs? I'll finalize by EOD tomorrow.

ashley.enable: I'll host Q&A and own pre-read. tom.se will do deep labs.

marie.cs: Great — locking Thu 2026-04-16 16:00 PT as primary (per votes). Updating invites + prep tracker. Thanks :tada:

ops_bot: Invite updated; meeting room set to "Remote - Workshop A". Reminder set 24h before.
